scope: Actual complete current-source regression batch; no historical test result reused

swipe_control_tb.summary: PASS left-swipe controller: 26 reset-isolated gestures, dx100/dy80 bounds, arbitrary start, release-coordinate independence, latest-point/vertical excursion/timeout cancellation, inactive long press, multitouch/offline/bounce protection, no click-through, exact fourth main-menu information button and page13 back, preserved feature controls

effects_ui_tb.summary: PASS all eight display choices, coherent 52-bit mailbox and three-choice WB navigation
